defmodule AuthService.SessionManager do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @session_ttl 3600
  @cleanup_interval 60_000

  defstruct sessions: %{}, pending_auth: %{}

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup_expired, @cleanup_interval)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{}}
  end

  def initiate_login(client_session_id, credentials) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:initiate_login, client_session_id, credentials})
  end

  def complete_login(auth_token) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:complete_login, auth_token})
  end

  def get_session(session_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_session, session_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:initiate_login, client_session_id, credentials}, _from, state) do
    case validate_credentials_async(credentials) do
      {:ok, task_ref} ->
        pending = Map.put(state.pending_auth, task_ref, %{
          session_id: client_session_id,
          credentials: credentials,
          initiated_at: System.system_time(:second)
        })
        {:reply, {:ok, task_ref}, %{state | pending_auth: pending}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:complete_login, auth_token}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.pending_auth, auth_token) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_token}, state}
      %{session_id: session_id, credentials: creds} = pending_info ->
        case verify_auth_result(auth_token, creds) do
          {:ok, user_info} ->
            # Bind authenticated user to the session
            session_data = %{
              user_id: user_info.id,
              roles: user_info.roles,
              authenticated_at: System.system_time(:second),
              expires_at: System.system_time(:second) + @session_ttl
            }
            # Use the session_id from the initial request
            updated_sessions = Map.put(state.sessions, session_id, session_data)
            updated_pending = Map.delete(state.pending_auth, auth_token)
            {:reply, {:ok, session_id, session_data},
              %{state | sessions: updated_sessions, pending_auth: updated_pending}}
          {:error, reason} ->
            updated_pending = Map.delete(state.pending_auth, auth_token)
            {:reply, {:error, reason}, %{state | pending_auth: updated_pending}}
        end
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:get_session, session_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.sessions, session_id) do
      nil -> {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      session ->
        if session.expires_at > System.system_time(:second) do
          {:reply, {:ok, session}, state}
        else
          updated = Map.delete(state.sessions, session_id)
          {:reply, {:error, :expired}, %{state | sessions: updated}}
        end
    end
  end

  def handle_info(:cleanup_expired, state) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    active_sessions = state.sessions
      |> Enum.filter(fn {_id, s} -> s.expires_at > now end)
      |> Map.new()
    active_pending = state.pending_auth
      |> Enum.filter(fn {_ref, p} -> now - p.initiated_at < 300 end)
      |> Map.new()
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup_expired, @cleanup_interval)
    {:noreply, %{state | sessions: active_sessions, pending_auth: active_pending}}
  end

  defp validate_credentials_async(credentials) do
    if valid_credential_format?(credentials) do
      ref = make_ref()
      Task.async(fn ->
        # Simulate async auth provider call
        Process.sleep(100)
        {:authenticated, ref, credentials.username}
      end)
      {:ok, ref}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  defp verify_auth_result(auth_token, credentials) do
    # In production this would verify with the auth provider
    {:ok, %{id: :crypto.hash(:sha256, credentials.username) |> Base.encode16(),
            roles: ["user"], username: credentials.username}}
  end

  defp valid_credential_format?(%{username: u, password: p})
    when is_binary(u) and is_binary(p) and byte_size(u) > 0 and byte_size(p) >= 8, do: true
  defp valid_credential_format?(_), do: false
end

defmodule AuthService.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/login" do
    session_id = get_or_create_session_id(conn)
    credentials = %{
      username: conn.body_params["username"],
      password: conn.body_params["password"]
    }

    case AuthService.SessionManager.initiate_login(session_id, credentials) do
      {:ok, auth_token} ->
        # Wait for async auth to complete, then finalize
        case AuthService.SessionManager.complete_login(auth_token) do
          {:ok, final_session_id, _session_data} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_header("set-cookie", "sid=#{final_session_id}; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict")
            |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "authenticated"}))
          {:error, reason} ->
            send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end

  get "/profile" do
    case extract_session_id(conn) do
      nil -> send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "no session"}))
      sid ->
        case AuthService.SessionManager.get_session(sid) do
          {:ok, session} ->
            send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{user_id: session.user_id, roles: session.roles}))
          {:error, _} ->
            send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "invalid session"}))
        end
    end
  end

  defp get_or_create_session_id(conn) do
    case extract_session_id(conn) do
      nil -> generate_session_id()
      existing -> existing
    end
  end

  defp extract_session_id(conn) do
    conn
    |> get_req_header("cookie")
    |> Enum.find_value(fn cookie_header ->
      cookie_header
      |> String.split(";")
      |> Enum.find_value(fn part ->
        case String.trim(part) |> String.split("=", parts: 2) do
          ["sid", value] -> String.trim(value)
          _ -> nil
        end
      end)
    end)
  end

  defp generate_session_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end
end
